data.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
data.detailed_description:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

■Explore the World on a Planetary Scale

Soar the skies with your airship—the Highwind—and explore a vast, interconnected world. Choose where to drop and skydive down to areas of interest across a wide variety of biomes, cities, and remote frontiers.

■An Iconic Ensemble, Fully United

Fight alongside a roster of unique companions, including newly playable party members Cid Highwind and Vincent Valentine. Each character brings distinct combat roles and abilities to the fray, greatly expanding your strategic options.

■Refined Action and Strategy

Experience the series’ iconic hybrid of real‑time action and command‑based combat in its most polished form yet. Seamlessly switch between party members, issue commands in Tactical Mode, and unleash powerful abilities and synergies to overcome colossal threats.

■Deep Customization and Builds

Prepare your team for the battles ahead with extensive customization options. Adjust your characters' weapons, armor, skills, materia, and FITS—a new system which adds class-based abilities and special outfits. Refine your builds to suit your playstyle and adapt to each unique encounter.

Those with save data* from the following titles will be eligible to receive this special offer.
FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE (Main Story)

  • Summoning Materia: Chocobo & Moogle

FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH

  • Summoning Materia: Phoenix

*Save data must be saved on the same PC that you will use for playing FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION.
*The account must be the same one used to play FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE and FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH.
*Save data for FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE EPISODE INTERmission are excluded.
